title: Organization
description: An organization that may belong to a group. This basic schema defines only common entity properties.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this organization.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Organization.

entityType.description: IFS entity category/type for this organization.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this organization record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this organization record was last updated.
